sql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', occurred_at) AS day, count(*) AS events
FROM analytics.events
WHERE occurred_at >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT account_id, sum(amount_usd) AS revenue_usd
FROM finance.invoices
WHERE paid_at >= date_trunc('month', now())
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT *
FROM warehouse.dim_customer
WHERE email ILIKE '%@gmail.com%'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT region, count(*) AS signups
FROM growth.user_signups
WHERE signup_date >= current_date - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT order_id, status, updated_at
FROM ops.orders
WHERE updated_at >= now() - interval '2 hours'
ORDER BY updated_at DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT merchant_name, sum(net_amount) AS net
FROM payments.settlements
WHERE settlement_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 25;

SELECT
  DATE(created_at) AS day,
  countif(event_name='checkout_started') AS checkout_started,
  countif(event_name='purchase') AS purchase
FROM web.events
WHERE created_at >= date_sub(current_date, interval 28 day)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT service, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95_ms
FROM observability.api_latency
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '1 day'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY p95_ms DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT count(*) AS failed_jobs
FROM etl.job_runs
WHERE finished_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
  AND status = 'failed';

SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS hour, count(*) AS tickets
FROM support.zendesk_tickets
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '72 hours'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT agent_email, avg(first_reply_minutes) AS avg_first_reply
FROM support.sla_metrics
WHERE day >= current_date - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2;

SELECT product_sku, sum(quantity) AS units
FROM retail.order_items
WHERE order_date >= date_trunc('quarter', current_date)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY units DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT count(*) AS late_shipments
FROM logistics.shipments
WHERE shipped_at >= current_date - interval '7 day'
  AND delivered_at > expected_delivery_at;

SELECT plan, count(*) AS active
FROM billing.subscriptions
WHERE status='active'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY active DESC;

SELECT date_trunc('day', paid_at) AS day, sum(amount_usd) AS amount
FROM billing.payments
WHERE paid_at >= now() - interval '60 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT country, count(*) AS users
FROM app.users
WHERE last_seen_at >= now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY users DESC
LIMIT 30;

SELECT *
FROM app.user_sessions
WHERE started_at >= now() - interval '1 day'
  AND device_type = 'ios'
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 500;

SELECT campaign, sum(spend_usd) AS spend
FROM marketing.ad_spend
WHERE day >= current_date - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY spend DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT source, count(*) AS leads
FROM marketing.leads
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY leads DESC;

SELECT *
FROM hr.employees
WHERE termination_date IS NULL
ORDER BY last_name, first_name;

SELECT department, count(*) AS headcount
FROM hr.employees
WHERE termination_date IS NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY headcount DESC;

SELECT project, sum(cost_usd) AS cost
FROM cloud.gcp_billing
WHERE usage_start_time >= timestamp_sub(current_timestamp(), interval 7 day)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT cluster, avg(cpu_utilization) AS avg_cpu
FROM infra.k8s_metrics
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_cpu DESC;

SELECT *
FROM billing.refunds
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '1 day'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 250;

SELECT user_id, count(*) AS errors
FROM web.client_errors
WHERE ts >= timestamp_sub(current_timestamp(), interval 24 hour)
GROUP BY 1
HAVING count(*) > 50
ORDER BY errors DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT ticket_id
FROM support.zendesk_tickets
WHERE tags @> ARRAY['vip']
  AND status IN ('new','open')
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT count(*)
FROM analytics.events
WHERE occurred_at >= now() - interval '1 hour'
  AND event_name = 'page_view';

SELECT job_name, status, finished_at
FROM etl.job_runs
WHERE started_at >= now() - interval '12 hours'
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT carrier, count(*) AS shipments
FROM logistics.shipments
WHERE shipped_at >= current_date - interval '30 day'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY shipments DESC;

SELECT *
FROM growth.ab_tests
WHERE ended_at IS NULL
ORDER BY started_at DESC;

SELECT user_id, email
FROM app.users
WHERE email ILIKE '%@yahoo.%'
LIMIT 200;

SELECT *
FROM cloud.incident_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '2 days'
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT user_id, count(*) AS sessions
FROM analytics.sessions
WHERE started_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY sessions DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT order_id
FROM web.checkout_events
WHERE event='payment_failed'
  AND ts >= timestamp_sub(current_timestamp(), interval 2 hour)
LIMIT 200;

SELECT *
FROM marketing.attribution
WHERE touch_ts >= now() - interval '3 days'
ORDER BY touch_ts DESC
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT count(*) AS backlog
FROM support.zendesk_tickets
WHERE status IN ('new','open')
  AND priority IN ('high','urgent');

SELECT *
FROM observability.api_errors
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '4 hours'
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 500;

SELECT user_id, email
FROM web.users
WHERE created_at >= timestamp_sub(current_timestamp(), interval 1 day)
  AND email IS NULL;

SELECT *
FROM analytics.events
WHERE occurred_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
ORDER BY occurred_at DESC;

SELECT count(*)
FROM observability.api_latency
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '1 hour'
  AND service = 'search-api';
